caption: The drawing depicts a fabric belt with a rectangular, ornate metal buckle positioned at the front center. The belt is rendered in a floral pattern featuring a mix of bright colors, including blue, pink, red, yellow, and green, with accents of brown lines that appear to mimic a wavy or branch-like design over a beige background. The fabric is shown folded to form a loop, with one end emerging from behind the buckle and resting on top of the other segment. The metal buckle is drawn with intricate detailing and features a scalloped or filigree-like border. Above and to the left of the belt, there is a small, monochromatic sketch of the buckle alone, illustrating its side profile and additional details. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the objects without distraction.
title: Belt
